notes:
Context: mid-market B2B SaaS (product analytics) building in-app semantic search and knowledge surfaces. Currently using hybrid vector store (pgvector for small clusters, Pinecone for prod). Wants to run nightly batch embedding jobs (estimate: 5–10M documents/month) and real-time retrieval for UI. Primary evaluation path: Hosted API demo → short POC on Hosted → Dedicated pilot if cost/latency match.

Key technical requirements / asks:
- Throughput: must support batch embedding ingestion of ~1M docs/day during ETL windows (parallelized jobs).
- Retrieval latency: target 30–80ms p95 for top-k retrieval in UI; currently seeing 120-250ms with their current stack on long queries.
- Integration: needs simple connector pattern for Pinecone and Postgres+pgvector; prefer minimal SDK changes.
- Cost sensitivity: mid-market budget; looking for predictable committed pricing vs pay-as-you-go.
- Security: SSO/SAML, SOC2, KMS for key management; retention and audit logs mandatory.

POC notes (shorthand):
- Team: Eng lead = Priya Rao, Data eng = Marco Silva, Product = Ben Holt.
- POC dataset = 500k product help articles + user comments; used 1536-d embedding model baseline.
- Initial hosted API run: good throughput, prefix caching reduced token cost for generated snippets.
- Problem: long-tail queries (~2% of traffic) trigger expensive rerankers and increase p95. SE recommended model fallback + KV-cache tuning.
- Customer asked: can Redwood route requests to cheaper quantized model for background batch jobs and higher-quality model for UI? "Yes, routing policies are key" (quote from Priya).

Commercial / procurement notes:
- Interested in a Dedicated commitment for predictable unit economics; initial ask is pricing for 8x GPU reserved pool with burst-to-hosted for peak.
- Wants 12-month and 24-month options; finance wants ARR predictability.
- Legal needs DPA + data residency language for NA only.

Open items / next actions:
- SE (Aisha) to run targeted throughput test against Pinecone connector and share config (due 2026-03-15).
- Product/AE to draft Dedicated pricing letter (Jordan) and show cost-per-embedding scenarios.
- Legal to provide sample DPA and residency language.
- Customer to provide production sample logs for tail-latency repro.
